body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> iRobot presented its cleaning robot 'Looj' at 2009 CES, which is designed to make gutter cleaning fast and easy. Avoid climbing and repositioning a ladder multiple times while juggling tools and over-reaching from dangerous heights. Controlled by a wireless remote control that doubles as a detachable handle, iRobot Looj drives through gutters to sweep out dirt and debris. With a fast-spinning bi-directional auger, iRobot Looj can clean up to a 60-foot section of gutter in just 10 minutes. Pricing for the iRobot Looj begins at $69.99.
